customManagers.description: Alpine packages annotated with `# renovate: alpine-package=<name>` in Dockerfile.template

packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript on v6 until @balena/lint (typescript-eslint) supports v7
Limit alpine base image lookups to semver versions (suppresses date-snapshot tag noise)
Stay on the Alpine 3.24 series: hold minor/major bumps as reviewable PRs in the queue (was dependencyDashboardApproval; the dependency dashboard is disabled fleet-wide).

Auto-merge Alpine apk version bumps (repology). Renovate writes the full version, with the -rN revision, back to Dockerfile.template. Most packages install with the fuzzy =~ operator. libcrypto3, libssl3 and zlib install as a floor with >=. CI gates the merge.
